name: The Comparator Engine
description: Sort engraved specimens through a traveling adjacent-pair comparator and three fixed controls.
natural_language: Seal the specimens from lightest to heaviest using ADVANCE, EXCHANGE and SEAL. The lamp shows the heavier side of its current pair. Same-size specimens can differ in weight. Stay within the visible comparison and lever reserves. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with unrelated, pre-existing, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task are allowed, and only their visible controls may be used.

metadata.notes: Original procedural brass specimen comparator. Temporal-memory selection hypothesis remains unproven; full cyclic local-comparison strategies are explicitly audited. Human and agent calibration pending.
